observations: Sticky content passing underneath fixed section navigation is native scrolling behavior. The translucent bar makes underlying copy visibly interfere with its labels; this is distinguished from an unintended layout-flow overlap.
Spark overlaps the rightmost visible rank in iPhone13 closed-state frames. This is recorded as existing covered pixels, not a request to expand repairs.
Open feedback content extends below short viewports; image review alone does not prove panel scroll reachability.
limitations: BEFORE only; no repaired/current-source acceptance claimed.
All84 independently inspected despite prior root pilot review; no root report modified.
No source edits or new maintenance scope.
